IDT12420.name: Derwent Estuary
IDT12420.text:
Thursday 19 November
Winds: South to southeasterly about 10 knots.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Cloudy.

Friday 20 November
Winds: Variable about 10 knots becoming east to northeasterly 10 to 15 knots in the early afternoon then becoming north to northeasterly below 10 knots in the late evening.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Cloudy. 70% chance of showers. The chance of a thunderstorm in the afternoon and early evening.

Saturday 21 November
Winds: Variable below 10 knots becoming southerly 10 to 15 knots in the middle of the day then becoming variable below 10 knots in the evening.
Seas: Below 1 metre.

Sunday 22 November
Winds: Northerly about 10 knots increasing to 15 to 20 knots during the day then decreasing to about 10 knots during the evening.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Cloudy. 90% chance of showers.

Monday 23 November
Winds: Northwesterly 10 to 15 knots turning westerly during the day.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Partly cloudy. 70% chance of showers.
IDT12420.synoptic: A high pressure system sits to the east of Tasmania, with a ridge to the south of Tasmania expected to weaken overnight. A low pressure system over the Bight will move to the southwest of Tasmania during Friday, with an associated trough to cross the state early on Saturday morning. A narrow ridge of high pressure will cross Tasmania overnight Saturday, ahead of a strong cold front to cross late Sunday and early Monday. A trough is expected to cross Tasmania during Monday and bring a cold southwesterly change.

Weather: Cloudy. 70% chance of showers. The chance of a thunderstorm inshore in the afternoon and early evening.

Seas: 1 to 1.5 metres, increasing to 1 to 2 metres during the morning.
